$comment: ExtractionResult: what the AI returns for ONE scanned page. Logical schema. If the structured-output API rejects a keyword, adapt the syntax only (for example type arrays to anyOf) and keep every field name, type and meaning.

is_requisition_form.description: false when the page is not a Material Field Requisition (blank page, other document).

crew_code.description: One of the crew codes given in the prompt, or null when it cannot be determined.

crew_printed_text.description: Printed text after 'Foreman/Responsible Crew:' exactly as printed.

requester.description: Handwritten or stamped foreman name that stands (not struck through). null when missing or scribbled out.

pb_location_raw.description: PB Locations field exactly as written, for example 'PB 55', '103', 'FOR LDYs'.

request_date_raw.description: Date field exactly as written, for example '9-8', '10/7/26'.

date_required_default_raw.description: The first 'Date Required by' value written anywhere in that column, exactly as written, even when it sits on a row with no quantity. null when the column is empty.

notes.description: Margin notes and anything unusual about the page.

line_no.description: 1-based order of the filled rows, top to bottom.

part_number_raw.description: Part # exactly as printed or handwritten on that row.

description_raw.description: Description exactly as printed or handwritten on that row.

is_write_in.description: true when the part number on the row is handwritten rather than pre-printed.

qty_raw.description: Qty Needed exactly as written, including unit words: '596 bolts', '1 Pallet/3840', "100's".

qty_each.description: Count of individual items when unambiguous, else null. For 'N Pallets/M' or 'N Boxes/M' use M.

date_required_raw.description: Date Required by exactly as written on that row, or null when blank.

sis_initialed.description: true when the SIS/IA column carries initials for this row, including a single initial with a line or arrow drawn down through this row.

note.description: Why confidence is not high, including the alternative reading: 'Reads 7,926; could be 7,924.'
